text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Names released of 183 new local government areas created in October.
- Leaders of Nigeria's five political parties will meet with head of state General Sani Abacha on Thursday to discuss issues related to forthcoming local government elections.

- Official commissioning of government's $1.5 billion Eleme Petrochemical Plant has been set for December 18. The plant, with an annual capacity of 250,000 tonnes of polyethylene has been working steadily for the past eight months .
- State-run Nigerian Telecommunications may not achieve its 31 billion naira revenue target set for 1996 if performance in the first half year is continued throughout.
- Finance minister Anthony Ani says budget emphasis in 1997 will move from ensuring stability to targeting growth and development.
